items.source: 1 Static factory method with a URI template. 2 Add or replace URI components. 3 Request to have the URI template and URI variables encoded. 4 Build a UriComponents. 5 Expand variables and obtain the URI.
items.translation: 1 带有 URI 模板的静态工厂方法。 2 添加或替换 URI 组件。 3 请求对 URI 模板和 URI 变量进行编码。 4 构建 UriComponents。 5 展开变量并获取 URI。

items.source: UriComponentsBuilder implements UriBuilder. You can create a UriBuilder, in turn, with a UriBuilderFactory. Together, UriBuilderFactory and UriBuilder provide a pluggable mechanism to build URIs from URI templates, based on shared configuration, such as a base URL, encoding preferences, and other details.
items.translation: UriComponentsBuilder 实现了 UriBuilder。您可以使用 UriBuilderFactory 来创建 UriBuilder。UriBuilderFactory 和 UriBuilder 共同提供了一种可插拔机制，用于基于共享配置（例如基础 URL、编码偏好和其他详细信息）从 URI 模板构建 URI。

items.source: You can configure RestTemplate and WebClient with a UriBuilderFactory to customize the preparation of URIs. DefaultUriBuilderFactory is a default implementation of UriBuilderFactory that uses UriComponentsBuilder internally and exposes shared configuration options.
items.translation: 您可以使用 UriBuilderFactory 配置 RestTemplate 和 WebClient，以自定义 URIs 的构建过程。DefaultUriBuilderFactory 是 UriBuilderFactory 的默认实现，内部使用 UriComponentsBuilder，并公开共享的配置选项。

items.source: The RestTemplate is set to EncodingMode.URI_COMPONENT for historical reasons and for backwards compatibility. The WebClient relies on the default value in DefaultUriBuilderFactory, which was changed from EncodingMode.URI_COMPONENT in 5.0.x to EncodingMode.TEMPLATE_AND_VALUES in 5.1.
items.translation: 由于历史原因和向后兼容性考虑，RestTemplate 被设置为 EncodingMode.URI_COMPONENT。WebClient 依赖于 DefaultUriBuilderFactory 中的默认值，该默认值在 5.0.x 版本中从 EncodingMode.URI_COMPONENT 更改为 5.1 版本中的 EncodingMode.TEMPLATE_AND_VALUES。

items.source: By default, RestClient, WebClient, and RestTemplate use the RFC parser type, and expect applications to provide with URL templates that conform to RFC syntax. To change that you can customize the UriBuilderFactory on any of the clients.
items.translation: 默认情况下，RestClient、WebClient 和 RestTemplate 使用 RFC 解析器类型，并期望应用程序提供符合 RFC 语法的 URL 模板。若要更改此设置，可以在任何客户端上自定义 UriBuilderFactory。

items.source: WhatWG parser — this parser is based on the URL parsing algorithm in the WhatWG URL Living standard. It provides lenient handling of a wide range of cases of unexpected input. Browsers implement this in order to handle leniently user typed URL’s. For more details, see the URL Living Standard and URL parsing test cases.
items.translation: WhatWG 解析器 — 该解析器基于 URL 解析算法（见 WhatWG URL 活标准）。它提供对广泛范围的意外输入情况的宽松处理。浏览器采用此方式以宽松地处理用户输入的 URL。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 URL 活标准和 URL 解析测试用例。

items.translation: WebClient 和 RestTemplate 通过 UriBuilderFactory 策略在内部扩展并编码 URI 模板。两者都可以通过自定义策略进行配置，如下例所示：

items.source: URI_COMPONENT: Uses UriComponents#encode(), corresponding to the second option in the earlier list, to encode URI component value after URI variables are expanded.
items.translation: URI_COMPONENT：使用 UriComponents#encode()（对应之前列表中的第二个选项）来编码 URI 组件值，该操作在展开 URI 变量之后进行。

items.source: In addition, you can also use DefaultUriBuilderFactory directly. It is similar to using UriComponentsBuilder but, instead of static factory methods, it is an actual instance that holds configuration and preferences, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 此外，您也可以直接使用 DefaultUriBuilderFactory。它与使用 UriComponentsBuilder 类似，但它是实际实例而非静态工厂方法，该实例持有配置和首选项，如下例所示：

items.source: UriComponents#encode(): Encodes URI components after URI variables are expanded.
items.translation: UriComponents#encode():在展开 URI 变量后对 URI 组件进行编码。

items.source: The DefaultUriBuilderFactory implementation uses UriComponentsBuilder internally to expand and encode URI templates. As a factory, it provides a single place to configure the approach to encoding, based on one of the below encoding modes:
items.translation: DefaultUriBuilderFactory 实现内部使用 UriComponentsBuilder 来扩展和编码 URI 模板。作为工厂，它提供了一个单一位置来配置编码方法，基于以下编码模式之一：

items.source: TEMPLATE_AND_VALUES: Uses UriComponentsBuilder#encode(), corresponding to the first option in the earlier list, to pre-encode the URI template and strictly encode URI variables when expanded.
items.translation: TEMPLATE_AND_VALUES：使用 UriComponentsBuilder#encode()，对应于之前列表中的第一个选项，用于预先编码 URI 模板并在展开时严格编码 URI 变量。

items.source: VALUES_ONLY: Does not encode the URI template and, instead, applies strict encoding to URI variables through UriUtils#encodeUriVariables prior to expanding them into the template.
items.translation: VALUES_ONLY：不对 URI 模板进行编码，而是通过 UriUtils#encodeUriVariables 对 URI 变量应用严格编码，然后再将它们展开到模板中。

items.source: Applications and frameworks may further rely on UriComponentsBuilder for their own needs to parse user provided URL’s in order to inspect and possibly validated URI components such as the scheme, host, port, path, and query. Such components can decide to use the WhatWG parser type in order to handle URL’s more leniently, and to align with the way browsers parse URI’s, in case of a redirect to the input URL or if it is included in a response to a browser.
items.translation: 应用程序和框架可能还需要依赖 UriComponentsBuilder 来满足自身需求，用于解析用户提供的 URL，以便检查并可能验证 URI 组件（如 scheme、host、port、path 和 query）。这些组件可以选择使用 WhatWG 解析器类型，以更宽松地处理 URL，并在发生重定向到输入 URL 或将其包含在浏览器响应时，与浏览器解析 URI 的方式保持一致。

items.source: UriComponentsBuilder exposes encoding options at two levels:
items.translation: UriComponentsBuilder 在两个级别上提供编码选项：

items.translation: UriComponentsBuilder#encode()：首先对 URI 模板进行预编码，然后在展开时严格编码 URI 变量。

items.source:
RFC parser — this parser type expects URI strings to conform to RFC 3986 syntax,
and treats deviations from the syntax as illegal.
items.translation: RFC 解析器 — 此解析器类型期望 URI 字符串符合 RFC 3986 语法，并将对语法的任何偏差视为非法。

items.source:
Both options replace non-ASCII and illegal characters with escaped octets. However, the first option
also replaces characters with reserved meaning that appear in URI variables.
items.translation: 这两种选项都会将非 ASCII 字符和非法字符替换为转义八位字节。然而，第一种选项还会替换出现在 URI 变量中具有保留含义的字符。

items.source:
For most cases, the first option is likely to give the expected result, because it treats URI
variables as opaque data to be fully encoded, while the second option is useful if URI
variables do intentionally contain reserved characters. The second option is also useful
when not expanding URI variables at all since that will also encode anything that
incidentally looks like a URI variable.
items.translation: 对于大多数情况，第一个选项可能会给出预期的结果，因为它将 URI 变量视为需要完全编码的不透明数据，而第二个选项在 URI 变量确实有意包含保留字符时很有用。当完全不展开 URI 变量时，第二个选项也很有用，因为这也会编码任何偶然看起来像 URI 变量的内容。
